title: Century Communities Sets Date for Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS), a leading national homebuilder, today announced that the Company will release its second quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Wednesday, July 22, 2026. A conference call will be held that same day at 5:00 p.m. Eastern time, 3:00 p.m. Mountain time, to review the Company's second quarter results, discuss recent events and conduct a question-and-answer session. Webcast: The conference call will be available in the Investors section of the Company's website at www.centurycommunities.com . To listen to a live broadcast, go to the site at least 15 minutes prior to the scheduled start time in order to register, download and install any necessary audio software. To Participate in the Telephone Conference Call: Dial in at least 5 minutes prior to start time Domestic: 1-833-461-5787 International: 1-585-542-9983 Conference ID: 338 306 020 About Century Communities: Century Communities, Inc.
